name: No Miss
description: Complete the level without getting hit once.

name: Close Call
description: Complete the level with at most one hit.

name: Pearl Sweep
description: Collect every pearl in the level.

name: Beat My Score
description: Outscore the best ghost on file.

name: Treasure Hunt
description: Collect all treasure coins in the level.

name: Power Free
description: Clear the level without firing any power.

name: One Shot
description: Use Bubble Burst at most once during the run.

name: Shield Run
description: Only activate Echo Shield — no other powers.

name: Speed Run
description: Clear the level on the very first attempt.

name: Tiny Challenge
description: Clear the level with the Tiny Pebble mutator active.

name: Upside Down
description: Clear the level with Reverse Buoyancy active.

name: Family Run
description: Complete a Pass & Play relay on this level.

name: High Tide
description: Score 1000 points or more in a single run.
